conventions.commits: Conventional Commits with type(scope): subject format; all commits must be GPG-signed with --signoff flag; types: feat, fix, docs, refactor, test, chore
conventions.testing: Unit tests in language module files (mod.rs) with test_*_element_query, test_*_extract_inheritance, test_*_defuse_query patterns; integration tests in crates/aptu-coder-core/tests/integration_tests.rs
conventions.linting: cargo fmt --check, cargo clippy -- -D warnings, cargo deny check advisories licenses; workspace lints enforce undocumented_unsafe_blocks, unwrap_used, expect_used as deny
conventions.error_handling: Use thiserror for error types; no unwrap() or expect() in production code (test-code exemptions via cfg_attr); bounds checks on source byte ranges before slicing

patterns: Language modules export ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY (Option), IMPORT_QUERY (Option), DEFUSE_QUERY (Option) as &str constants
extract_function_name, find_method_for_receiver, find_receiver_type, extract_inheritance are optional handler functions matching type aliases
get_language_info() match arm returns LanguageInfo struct with all fields populated; get_ts_language() returns tree-sitter Language object
EXTENSION_MAP in lang.rs maps file extensions to language identifiers; supported_languages() returns static slice of all language names
Tree-sitter queries use capture groups (@func_name, @class_name, @call, @read.usage, @write.assign, etc.) for semantic classification
Inheritance extraction walks tree-sitter node tree via child_by_field_name() to find base_clause and class_interface_clause children
DEFUSE_QUERY patterns: local_variable_declaration with @write.local, assignment_expression with @write.assign, update_expression with @writeread.update, identifier with @read.usage
constraints: tree-sitter-php must be added to workspace.dependencies in Cargo.toml with version matching crates.io (0.25.2 or compatible)
PHP language handler must follow existing module structure: php.rs in crates/aptu-coder-core/src/languages/
All queries must compile against tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 grammar; node kinds and field names must match grammar exactly
DEFUSE_QUERY is required for PHP (not optional like CSS/YAML/Markdown) because PHP is a procedural/OOP language with local scope tracking
extract_inheritance must handle PHP's base_clause (extends) and class_interface_clause (implements) as child nodes, not fields
PHP grammar distinguishes function_definition (top-level) from method_declaration (inside class/interface/trait/enum)
test_coverage: Existing tests for each language module cover: element_query compilation and matching (functions/classes/interfaces), extract_inheritance with extends/implements, defuse_query write/read site detection, extract_function_name and receiver type extraction. Integration tests verify language registration in get_language_info() and file extension mapping.

library_findings.relevant_api: LANGUAGE constant, node types: function_definition, method_declaration, class_declaration, interface_declaration, trait_declaration, enum_declaration; fields: name, body; child nodes: base_clause, class_interface_clause
library_findings.notes: PHP grammar uses base_clause and class_interface_clause as child nodes (not fields) for inheritance; function_definition is top-level, method_declaration is inside class/interface/trait/enum; all declarations have name field and body field

library_findings.relevant_api: Query::new(), QueryCursor::matches(), Node::child_by_field_name(), Node::named_child(), Node::kind(), Node::start_byte(), Node::end_byte()
library_findings.notes: Core parsing and node traversal API; field access via child_by_field_name() for named fields; named_child() for positional access; kind() returns node type string

approaches.name: Minimal PHP support (functions and classes only)
approaches.description: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY capturing function_definition and method_declaration as @function, class_declaration/interface_declaration/trait_declaration/enum_declaration as @class. Implement CALL_QUERY for method_invocation. Implement DEFUSE_QUERY for local variable tracking. Skip extract_inheritance (return empty Vec). Register in mod.rs and lang.rs.
cons: No receiver type or method-for-receiver handlers

approaches.name: Full PHP support with inheritance and receiver tracking
approaches.description: Add php.rs with complete ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY. Implement extract_function_name, find_receiver_type, find_method_for_receiver, extract_inheritance. extract_inheritance walks base_clause and class_interface_clause children to collect parent class and interface names. Register in mod.rs, lang.rs, and Cargo.toml. Add 9+ test cases covering all declaration kinds and inheritance patterns.
pros: Complete language support matching Java/Go/TypeScript feature parity
Receiver type tracking supports method resolution
Comprehensive test coverage validates grammar assumptions
cons: More complex inheritance walking (base_clause is child node, not field)

approaches.name: Phased approach: MVP + inheritance in follow-up
approaches.description: Phase 1: Add php.rs with ELEMENT_QUERY, CALL_QUERY, DEFUSE_QUERY only; extract_inheritance returns empty Vec; minimal tests. Phase 2 (follow-up PR): Add REFERENCE_QUERY, IMPORT_QUERY, implement all handlers, add inheritance walking and comprehensive tests.
pros: Reduces initial PR scope and review burden
Allows early feedback on query correctness
cons: Requires two PRs and two review cycles
Incomplete feature set in Phase 1 (no inheritance)

recommendation: Approach 2 (Full PHP support with inheritance and receiver tracking). The issue explicitly asks for PHP support and the codebase pattern (Java, Go, TypeScript) establishes full-featured language support as the standard. Inheritance extraction is required for call-graph analysis and method resolution. The medium complexity is justified by the feature completeness and consistency with existing language integrations. All required information is available from tree-sitter-php 0.25.2 grammar documentation.
language_info_struct_citation:
pub struct LanguageInfo {
    pub name: &'static str,
    pub language: Language,
    pub element_query: &'static str,
    pub call_query: &'static str,
    pub reference_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub import_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub impl_trait_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub defuse_query: Option<&'static str>,
    pub extract_function_name: Option<ExtractFunctionNameHandler>,
    pub find_method_for_receiver: Option<FindMethodForReceiverHandler>,
    pub find_receiver_type: Option<FindReceiverTypeHandler>,
    pub extract_inheritance: Option<ExtractInheritanceHandler>,
}
element_query_draft:
pub const ELEMENT_QUERY: &str = r"
(function_definition
  name: (name) @func_name) @function
(method_declaration
  name: (name) @method_name) @function
(class_declaration
  name: (name) @class_name) @class
(interface_declaration
  name: (name) @interface_name) @class
(trait_declaration
  name: (name) @trait_name) @class
(enum_declaration
  name: (name) @enum_name) @class
";
defuse_query_draft:
pub const DEFUSE_QUERY: &str = r"
(simple_parameter name: (variable_name (name) @write.param))
(property_declaration (property_element name: (variable_name (name) @write.property)))
(assignment_expression left: (variable_name (name) @write.assign))
(assignment_expression left: (subscript_expression (variable_name (name) @write.subscript)))
(update_expression (variable_name (name) @writeread.update))
(variable_name (name) @read.usage)
";
inheritance_walk_citation: In tree-sitter-php grammar, class_declaration has three children: attributes (optional attribute_list), body (required declaration_list), and name (required name field). Inheritance is represented as child nodes (not fields): base_clause contains the parent class name (accessed via child_by_field_name('base_clause'), then iterate named_child to find name nodes), and class_interface_clause contains interface names (accessed via child_by_field_name('class_interface_clause'), then iterate named_child to find name nodes). The extraction walks: class_declaration -> base_clause -> name (extends), class_declaration -> class_interface_clause -> name (implements). Source: tree-sitter-php grammar rule in common/define-grammar.js and php/src/node-types.json.
